# Simplification rules

The Awtsmoos is One; the user-facing motion should therefore feel like one river, not many competing mechanisms.

- Auto Scroll has two visible states: Start and Stop.
- No countdown in the ordinary UI.
- No automatic pause merely because a menu, Lens, dialog, touch, wheel, or reading key appears; the user can stop when desired.
- Pace remains adjustable, but only one clear speed control is primary.
- Unit, preset, eye-line, density, and estimate machinery may remain internally compatible but must not crowd the default mobile surface.
- Reader appearance options belong behind a single expandable Appearance section.
- Main Menu should prioritize navigation labels, not long explanations.
- Ikar should identify itself as a Torah Library with Hebrew/English identity and meaningful section names; internal readiness language should not be prominent UI.
- No new `!important`; rewrite active owners rather than escalate specificity.

## NEXT_ACTION

Apply these rules to AutoScrollButton/Controller/Session/Wiring, Lens semantic controls/markup, menu renderer/styles, and Ikar fallback/first-light CSS.
